bullets.content: Look for '[ROAM_DECISION] [SPECIAL] [roamingDecisionHandleEventMissedBeacons]' with consecutive count >= extended threshold; this is the definitive missed-beacon disconnect trigger.
19 consecutive missed beacons (~1.9s at 100ms interval) with no roaming candidate forces client-side DEAUTH_REQ; classify as RF_INTERFERENCE even when RSSI was adequate before the event.

After confirming missed-beacon root cause check: (1) DeauthFrame_IsPresent=0 confirms client-side initiation; (2) RSSI before event to rule out signal degradation; (3) roaming candidates to explain hard disconnect.
